source_note: Second search pass 2026-10-21 (Z.ai web search + reader, browser-rendered JS): gened.college.harvard.edu/directory/happiness/ and coursebrowser.dce.harvard.edu/course/happiness/ give only course overviews; the official syllabus host harvard.simplesyllabus.com (PHIL E-155 companion, Fall 2025 and Spring 2026 sections, browser-rendered) states 'Full syllabus displayed to registered students only' — no session list is public anywhere. What IS publicly verifiable from that syllabus: the course runs as 22 reading-quiz-covered lecture topics, two per week (Tue/Thu lectures streamed from the FAS companion Gen Ed 1025), plus a midterm, a final, and a course project. A pre-2020 Scribd upload of an earlier Harvard 'Happiness' syllabus (PHIL 20) exists but is access-gated and is a different earlier course, so it was not used. Lectures stay honestly empty.
